headline: 蜘蛛侠新日登顶，奥德赛热度不减
headlineEn: Spider-Man: Brand New Day tops; Odyssey stays hot
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周共3部新片。今日热搜由《最后孤屋》《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》《奥德赛》领衔；《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》登顶周榜，多部影片持续热议。待映新片包括《最后的日出》《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》。
summaryEn: No new films hit theaters today; 3 new movies opened this week. Today’s trending is led by The Last Lonely House, Spider-Man: Brand New Day, and The Odyssey, while Spider-Man tops the weekly chart. Upcoming titles include The Last Sunrise, Escape from Death Street, and OK Boss Lady 2.

industryHighlights.text: 今日院线零新片，本周仅3部新片上映，市场热度由既有影片带动。
industryHighlights.en: Zero new releases today; only 3 films opened this week, with momentum driven by existing titles.

industryHighlights.text: 《蜘蛛侠：崭新之日》同时位列今日与本周热搜前列，显示较强观影关注。
industryHighlights.en: Spider-Man: Brand New Day ranks high in both daily and weekly trends, showing strong audience buzz.

industryHighlights.text: 《奥德赛》持续占据热搜，话题效应长线发酵。
industryHighlights.en: The Odyssey remains a trending topic with sustained word-of-mouth.

industryHighlights.text: 待映片单释出：《最后的日出》《逃出绝命街》《OK老板娘2》备受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming slate includes The Last Sunrise, Escape from Death Street, and OK Boss Lady 2.
